Definition: an Azzathite or inhabitant of Azzah
BiblicalUsage: An Azzathite is an inhabitant of Azzah, of Gaza. Joshua lists the land of the Philistines still to be possessed, and Judges says the men of Gaza lay in wait for Samson at the gate of the city all night.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the men of Gaza who waited all night for Samson waited in vain, because God had already given his servant strength to leave.
